posts.title: Attention Paradox
posts.description: Do you ever catch yourself closing Instagram or TikTok, only to reopen the exact same app a few seconds later? If you do, you’re not alone [1] [2] . It’s one of the defining phenomena in the age of social media and AI. posts.title: Looking Ahead to 2026
posts.description: As I head into 2026 having finished my OMSCS degree, there is a void left to keep myself mentally occupied after work. Through all of the endless weekends and all-nighters, the program had given me a structure to fill up my “free” time with deadlines and purpose to expand my knowledge through the course content which no longer exists.
